pageTitle: cyWhat are your grounds for possession?
heading: cyWhat are your grounds for possession?
paragraphs: cyOn the notice you served, you should have already selected your possession grounds. You should select these grounds here, and any other grounds you want to add to your claim.
cyRead guidance about possession grounds (opens in new tab).

discretionary.hint: cyIf you make a claim on discretionary grounds, a judge can decide whether to grant possession. You will need to demonstrate that possession is reasonable. Select all that apply.

mandatory.hint: cyIf you make a claim on mandatory grounds, the court will accept your reasons for possession if they can be proven. Select all that apply.
